title: The header offers only the one finish action that is genuinely next
pre:
1. You are signed in with invoicing and review permissions.
2. Work orders exist in each combination of review on/off and lines open/complete/reviewed.
steps:
1. With review off and a line still open, read the header actions.
2. With review off and every line complete.
3. With review on and a line still open.
4. With review on, every line complete, not yet reviewed.
5. With review on, already reviewed.
6. With lines selected.
exp:
1. Review off, any line still open: New Line, Send, and a ... menu holding Create invoice.
2. Review off, every line complete: Create invoice promoted to a primary button beside New Line, then Send and ...
3. Review on, any line still open: New Line, Send, ... and no finish action at all (the next real action is completing the lines, on the line and in the bulk bar).
4. Any line still in Needs Approval: Create invoice is shown disabled (not hidden) with the reason "All lines must be approved before invoicing"; invoicing never approves a line as a side effect. A work order whose lines are all in Needs Approval offers no finish action at all - the next real action is approving the lines, on the line or in the bulk action bar.
5. Review on, every line complete, not yet reviewed: Mark as reviewed promoted beside New Line.
6. Review on, already reviewed: Create invoice promoted in its place.
7. Lines selected: the bulk action bar, whatever the review setting.
8. Only one finish action is ever on screen, and only ever one the user can actually press.
---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9264 (Story 18, Create invoice as the finish action) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 8 September 2026.

title: Create invoice runs the wizard if needed, then invoices and opens payment
pre:
1. You are signed in with Invoicing & Payments: Create & Edit + See Financial Data.
2. A work order has open lines, some with outstanding collectable work; and one where a deposit covers the whole amount.
steps:
1. Press Create invoice on a work order with outstanding required work.
2. Confirm and complete the flow.
3. Repeat where a deposit covers the whole amount.
exp:
1. Create invoice runs the wizard first if anything required is outstanding, otherwise proceeds directly.
2. If lines are still open, the confirmation states the invoice total and how many Approved lines will be completed; declined lines are named as excluded rather than counted.
3. On completion the invoice is created, every open Approved line completes, and the Finance tab opens with the payment screen. A declined line never blocks invoicing - it is skipped entirely.
4. Where a deposit already covers the whole amount the payment screen is skipped, the work order reads Paid, and the user is told the deposit settled the invoice.
5. Everything that happens today when an invoice is created still happens from every entry point: a deposit applying, an over-payment becoming a credit, the customer being locked, the accounting sync and the snapshot.
---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9264 (Story 18, Create invoice as the finish action) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 8 September 2026.

title: Finish-action negatives: reviewer, invoice lock, declined-only, no permission
pre:
1. You can sign in as: a user who may review but not invoice; a user who may only complete lines; a user without See Financial Data.
2. Work orders exist that are all-declined, already invoiced, and awaiting review.
steps:
1. As a review-only user, complete review and look at the header.
2. As a complete-only user, look at the header.
3. As a user without See Financial Data, look for Create invoice.
4. Check an all-declined work order and an already-invoiced one.
5. Close the payment screen after invoicing.
exp:
1. Mark as reviewed never completes a line, never opens the wizard and never asks for a confirmation.
2. Closing the payment screen rolls nothing back: the invoice stands, lines stay complete, the work order stays invoiced with a balance owing.
3. With review required, Create invoice is not offered until the work order is reviewed.
4. Where every line is declined there is no finish action (nothing to review or invoice).
5. Once an invoice exists, both actions are gone from the header and the ... menu.
6. A user who may review but not invoice sees Mark as reviewed then nothing further; a complete-only user sees nothing in the header; a user without See Financial Data does not see Create invoice at all.
---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9264 (Story 18, Create invoice as the finish action) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 9 September 2026.
